title: Rewinding the input head
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be finite Boolean words, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j \le |x|$. Starting in state $1$ with the input head at position $j$ and the work head at position $j-1$, with work tape storing $w$ and empty output, the copier reaches after $j+1$ steps the configuration in state $2$ with the input head at position $1$, the work head at position $0$, the work tape still storing $w$, and empty output.
replaced: For every input word $x$, copied word $w$, and prefix length $j \le |x|$, running the copier in its rewind control with the input head at $j$ and work head at $j - 1$ for $j + 1$ steps returns both heads to their origins and enters the return control; the physical left boundary identifies the origin without an unbounded control counter.
